findings.source_passage: like the feathers of an albatross, which sometimes are cast to the winds when that storm-tossed bird is on the wing
findings.source_locator: paragraph 3, describing cut sails eddying away to leeward
findings.why_it_matters: The albatross simile is a distinctive Melvillean image linking the storm action to the novel's broader symbolic register; its excision removes a characteristic rhetorical flourish and thematic resonance.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the simile: 'went eddying away to leeward, like the feathers of an albatross, which sometimes are cast to the winds when that storm-tossed bird is on the wing.'

findings.source_passage: But if I wake thee not to death, old man, who can tell to what unsounded deeps Starbuck's body this day week may sink, with all the crew!
findings.source_locator: final paragraph of Starbuck's interior monologue, between 'Oh Mary! Mary!—boy! boy! boy!' and 'Great God, where art Thou?'
findings.why_it_matters: This sentence is the pivot of Starbuck's moral calculus—killing Ahab as self-preservation for the crew—and is interpretively essential; its absence cuts the full weight of the 'shall I?' anguish.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the line verbatim between the 'boy! boy! boy!' exclamation and 'Great God, where art Thou?'

findings.source_passage: Such were the sounds that now came hurtling from out the old man's tormented sleep, as if Starbuck's voice had caused the long dumb dream to speak.
findings.why_it_matters: The full sentence contains the distinctive 'long dumb dream to speak' clause, which is interpretively weighted and rhythmically memorable; the draft reduces it to 'Such were the sounds from the old man's tormented sleep.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the complete sentence: 'Such were the sounds that now came hurtling from out the old man's tormented sleep, as if Starbuck's voice had caused the long dumb dream to speak.'

summary: The draft preserves all high-priority material including the full Starbuck soliloquy nearly verbatim, but drops the albatross simile and truncates two other distinctive passages at medium severity, falling below the regeneration threshold.
